description: Reservoirs of the Greater Mekong Subregion is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. This point layer (GRanDReservoirsv11) represents the locations and attribute information of reservoirs contained in the GRanD database, version 1. 1. For details please refer to the Technical Documentation. \r\nThe Global Reservoir and Dam (GRanD) database contains the world's largest dams and their associated reservoirs. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Agriculture, Energy, Irrigation and water management. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2016-02-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
